title: Staircase, Glass Balustrade & Steelwork
activity: Staircase, glass balustrade and structural steel
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Are anchors at the specified embedment, with curing time observed before loading?
Bolts torqued to the specified values and witnessed?
Are components level, landings level and twist within tolerance?
Is the glass the approved type, undamaged, with clamps/channel fixed as detailed?
Are weld inspection records available for site welds?
Anchors at 150 mm embedment (vertical and horizontal) as fabrication drawings?
Welds in material ≥8 mm thick radiographed/ultrasonic tested as specified?
